items.title: 盘点 Authority Server 强证据就绪状态
items.context: 读取 authority_status / conduit_status / policy discovery，确认 mode、URL、actor key、runner/session、receipt verification prerequisites；不得把 readiness warning 当作强证据。
items.userSees: User sees "Authority readiness: BLOCKED (authorityUrlConfigured=false, actorKeyConfigured=false, runnerConfigured=false, sessionConfigured=false, serverPublicKeyPinned=false)".

happy.desc: authority_status and conduit_status are captured without submitting evidence or verifying receipts.

edge.desc: Missing Authority URL / actor / runner / session / server key fields are represented as blockers, not as strong evidence.

adversarial.desc: Reject any report that sets receiptVerified=true or productionDone=true without verified AuthorityReceipt output.

verificationEvidence.note: authority-strong-evidence-report.json captures authority_status and conduit_status outputs without submitting evidence or verifying receipts; receiptVerified=false and productionDone=false.

mechanical verifier confirmed authorityUrlConfigured=false, actorKeyConfigured=false, runnerConfigured=false, sessionConfigured=false, serverPublicKeyPinned=false are represented as BLOCKED readiness fields.
mechanical verifier rejects receiptVerified=true/productionDone=true; current report keeps both false and no AuthorityReceipt is claimed.

items.title: 尝试提交 Authority job 并获取 receipt 证据
items.context: 构造最小 verification job plan 或 planner job，使用 authority_job_create / authority_job_status / receipt fetch/verify 路径。若服务或凭据不可用，记录 fail-closed 阻断原因。
items.userSees: User sees "Authority receipt: BLOCKED (no verified AuthorityReceipt; receiptVerified=false; productionDone=false)".

happy.desc: A real authority_job_create attempt is made or skipped only after a prerequisite command proves the Authority URL is absent.

edge.desc: No jobId, receiptId, or receiptFile is invented when Authority Server submission is unavailable.

adversarial.desc: Reject treating authority_enforce_policy failure, local storage, or handoff receipts as native AuthorityReceipt verification.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice authority_enforce_policy --json; node -e artifact invariant check
verificationEvidence.note: policy discovery failed closed because LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL is unset; report records authorityJobCreate.status=skipped_missing_url only after readiness proved no Authority URL exists.
mechanical verifier confirmed no jobId, receiptId, or receiptFile keys exist anywhere in the JSON report.
report treats authority_enforce_policy failure and local diagnostics as non-receipt evidence; receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, strongEvidenceConsumed=false.

items.title: 输出强证据验证结果并保持 gate 边界一致
items.context: 产出本 story 的 evidence 报告：receipt-backed 成功则写 receipt refs 和验证摘要；失败则写 authorityMode 未升级、receiptVerified=false 的 blocked/audit 结果，确保不影响本地 DONE 语义。
items.userSees: User sees "Authority strong evidence verification: BLOCKED fail-closed" plus concrete next actions for enabling receipt-backed PASS later.

happy.desc: The final report summarizes readiness, job attempt, receipt verification state, and next actions in one cold-readable artifact.

edge.desc: B-0a80/B-688d local lifecycle artifacts remain local and are not upgraded to receipt-backed evidence.

adversarial.desc: Reject any gate or report wording that implies Authority Server strong evidence was consumed when receipt verification did not happen.
